title: Numbers One to Ten
label: ch:numbers-1-10
canDo: I can count from one to ten in French and use the numbers in a short exchange.

payoff.summary: The ten most-reused words in the language, taken one at a time. Each is a Latin numeral that barely moved on its way into French, so English has already handed you half of them — and four of them left a copy of themselves in the calendar, still counting two months out of place.
payoff.note: Chapter 6 is schema-v2 as of the handwritten-chapter retirement, so the payoff is atom-scored: FR-C06-practice assesses every atom the chapter introduces.
